find_by_name.description: Look up an existing node's token by (kind, label) — check here before minting, or you create a duplicate. Optional `graph` bounds the lookup to one scope, which is what a reuse-or-mint decision needs: unscoped, a node of the same name in another scope reuses across the two. In-scope means the node is the SUBJECT of a current fact in that graph — the same definition the `nodes` verb enumerates.

graph.description: Bound the lookup to this scope; omitted, every scope.

find_by_name.name: find_by_name

outputSchema.title: graph_find_by_name — the answer
outputSchema.description: The live node tokens carrying a label (and kind, optionally within one graph), as {items} of hex tokens; a miss is an empty list, never null. chaos answers the list wrapped as {items} (an output schema's root must be an object), the shape this schema holds it to (stellar-core F17 346). A refusal is NOT described here: it is an isError result {code, detail} (refusal.schema.json), and its code is in contracts/refusal-codes.toml.

quads_from.description: Read the outgoing quads of given subjects, either current or as-of a past transaction. Pass depth (1-5, default 2) to choose how much comes back: 1 the count alone, 2 the [s,p,o,g] hex arrays, 3 objects with the predicate and scope named, 4 adds both nodes' readable styx addresses, 5 adds the object's domain. DEPRECATED, accepted for one minor: full:true is depth 5. A default call answers depth 2: the array shape is positional and somebody parses it.

as_of_tx.description: Read as of this transaction; omitted, current.

depth.description: how far down to answer, 1..5 over quad → quad → quad → address → domain. 1 {count}: how many quads, none listed [reads the quad index; grows with nothing: one integer] · 2 (default) + items as positional [s,p,o,g] hex arrays: today's answer [reads the chaos store (current facts); grows with the quads matched] · 3 + items as objects: s, p, o, g with the predicate and scope named (`predicate`, `graph`) [reads the chaos store (current facts), predicate and scope names; grows with one name pair per quad] · 4 + `s_styx` and `o_styx`: the readable address of both nodes [reads the chaos store (current facts), styx addresses; grows with two addresses per quad] · 5 + `o_domain`: the object's domain (what `full` asked, whole) [reads the chaos store (current facts), object domains; grows with one domain per quad]. Cumulative and nested.

full.description: DEPRECATED, accepted for one minor: full:true is depth 5. Use `depth`; an explicit depth wins over this flag.

graph.description: Only quads in this scope; omitted, every scope.

predicates.description: Predicate names or name-hashes to keep; empty items are refused.

subjects.description: The subjects whose outgoing quads to read.

quads_from.name: quads_from

outputSchema.title: graph_quads_from — the answer
outputSchema.description: The current quads whose subject is one of the asked subjects (or as of a past transaction), as {items}: each a [s, p, o, g] list of four hex tokens, or, when full is asked for, an object with s, p, predicate, o, o_domain, g, graph and the optional s_styx and o_styx. chaos answers the list wrapped as {items} (an output schema's root must be an object), the shape this schema holds it to (stellar-core F17 346). The answer states a depth when the call names one, and only then (the depth Adverb, stellar-core F17; schema/adverb's ladder: quad, quad, quad, address, domain; default 2, the answer graph_quads_from gave before the dial). 1 keeps the count; 2 gives the positional [s,p,o,g] arrays; 3 gives objects with the predicate and scope named; 4 adds s_styx and o_styx; 5 adds o_domain. The old `full` argument is deprecated and resolves to 5 (accepted for one minor). An out-of-range depth refuses depth_out_of_range. A refusal is NOT described here: it is an isError result {code, detail} (refusal.schema.json), and its code is in contracts/refusal-codes.toml.

depth.description: The depth this answer was given at; present exactly when the call named a depth (the depth Adverb, stellar-core F17; schema/adverb's ladder for this verb).

count.description: How many items the full answer lists; the whole answer at depth 1.

register_graph.description: Register a provenance graph before anything may write to it; writes to an unregistered scope are refused.
